info.title: glimpse
info.description: Render any UI or diagram to a PNG so an agent can see it, critique it, and iterate.

options.name: --renderer
options.description: mermaid | graphviz | d2 | web | app (default: from the file extension)

options.name: --name
options.description: snapshot name (default: from the source file or window)

options.name: --out
options.description: output folder (default: the project's glimpse folder)

options.name: --window
options.description: app window owner to capture; --title narrows it by title

options.name: --no-manifest
options.description: don't record the snapshot in manifest.json

options.name: --prune
options.description: remove other snapshots from the output folder
